ruleDefinitions.name: Hidden User Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of a hidden user account on macOS (UserID < 500) or with IsHidden option

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/dscl$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*create.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*UniqueID.*") AND process_command_line = RGX("([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|[1-4][0-9]{2})")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/dscl$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*create.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*IsHidden.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*true.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*yes.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*1.*")))
